summary.name: Blender
summary.one_liner: Blender is a free, open source 3D creation suite covering modeling, sculpting, rendering, VFX tracking, animation, rigging and 2D drawing in 3D.
use_cases: camera and object tracking on footage
summary.what_it_does: Blender is a 3D creation application licensed under the GNU GPL and developed as a public project. Its Cycles engine is a built-in unbiased path tracer with CPU and GPU rendering, real-time viewport preview, and PBR shaders with HDR lighting. Modeling tools include N-gon support, edge slide, inset, bridge fill, multi-resolution and dynamic subdivision, advanced sculpt brushes, and 3D texture painting. It also provides auto and manual camera and object tracking, rigging tools such as envelope, skeleton and automatic skinning, a curve editor and dope sheets, and sound synchronization. A 2D drawing mode lets users draw with onion skinning directly in the 3D viewport. The interface and tools can be customized through a Python API, and the page notes hundreds of community add-ons.
notable: Free and open source under GNU GPL, owned by its contributors
Cycles built-in unbiased path-tracer with CPU and GPU rendering
Built-in camera and object tracking with live preview in 3D scene
Python-controlled interface and API for add-ons and custom tools
caveats: Platforms supported are not named on the page text itself
